out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The following farm-raised fish served raw or partially cooked were observed without a written statement from the supplier stating that the fish were raised and fed according to 3-402.11(B)(3).: SALMON
violations.corrective_action: Contact your fish supplier and ask for a written statement stating that the fish were raised in net pens if in open water OR land-based operations AND fed formulated feed that contains no live parasites. FAX a copy of this letter to your inspector and keep this statement on site at the food establishment for 90 days beyond the time of service of the fish. CONTACT YOUR FISH SUPPLIER TO OBTAIN A PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FOR THE SALMON. SEND PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER TO EHS BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) marinated Raw chicken was observed being stored over cooked potatoes in the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW CHICKEN UNDERNEATH THE COOKED POTATOES. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: Observed inconsistent date marking on cooked and prepared foods.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO START DATE MARKING ALL COOKED AND PREPARED FOODS SO THAT ALL EMPLOYEES KNOW HOW OLD THE FOOD IS. SELL OR DISCARD FOOD WITHIN 7 DAYS OF THE DATE. SEE DATE MARKING FACT SHEET.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder statement: SALMON, RACK OF LAMB
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO PLACE AN ASTERISK * BY THE SALMON AND RACK OF LAMB ON THE NEW MENUS. STAFF DREW AN ASTERISK ON ONE MENU AND WILL COMPLETE THE REST LATER. ENSURE ALL NEW MENUS HAVE AN ASTERISK BY THE SALMON AND RACK OF LAMB. BOLLYWOOD BISTRO (Inspection Date: 05/04/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Observed staff drink out of an open blue cup while on the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF AND PIC THAT DRINKING BEVERAGES SHOULD BE DONE WITH A CLOSED CONTAINER.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff wash his hands with the spray nozzle at the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO WASH HIS HANDS AT THE HAND WASHING SINK. STAFF WASHED HIS HANDS AT THE HAND SINK.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handsink basin next to the prep sink was observed filled with empty squeeze bottles.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC MOVED ALL OF THE SQUEEZE BOTTLES TO THE DISH MACHINE. THE HANDSINK IS FOR HANDWASHING ONLY. DO NOT BLOCK OR OBSTRUCT ACCESS TO HANDSINKS.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: salmon
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. PROVIDE EHS WITH A PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FOR THE SALMON BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: 1) lamb chops in the Champe; 2) salmon in the Machhi Kabob.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PLEASE ADD A CONSUMER ADVISORY ASTERISK * NEXT TO THE LAMB CHOP AND THE SALMON TO INDICATE THESE ITEMS ARE OFFERED UNDERCOOKED. PLEASE ADD A CONSUMER ADVISORY DISCLOSURE STATEMENT AT INDICATE THAT THE ASTERISKED * ITEMS ARE UNDERCOOKED AND CONSUMING UNDERCOOKED OR RAW FOOD MAY HAVE AN INCREASED RISK OF FOOD-BORNE ILLNESSES. SEND EHS THE CORRECTED MENUS BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. BOLLYWOOD BISTRO (Inspection Date: 11/17/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) battered deep fried spinach was observed at 77f; 2) unsalted butter was observed at 115f. Butter was melted 1 hour ago.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED THE SPINACH. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD THE UNSALTED BUTTER IN 3 HOURS. EHS WILL PROVIDE A TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL DOCUMENT FOR THE FRIED SPINACH AND THE UNSALTED BUTTER.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) fried chicken was observed at 47f in the 6DWR under counter cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE CHICKEN.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed personal medication being stored on a shelf next to cooking ingredients.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. PIC MOVED THE PERSONAL MEDICATION OUT OF THE KITCHEN.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food was observed being stored on the floor of the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO ELEVATE FOOD OFF OF THE FLOOR. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION AND MAY WARRANT ENFORCEMENT IF IT CONTINUES.

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: Pink discoloration was observed inside the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO THOROUGHLY CLEAN THE ICE MACHINE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 6DWR under counter cooler was observed at 44f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC REPAIR THIS COOLER. COOLERS WORK BEST WHEN SET TO 32f-38f.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: Observed food being stored in plastic take-out bags in the freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO STOP USING PLASTIC TAKE-OUT BAGS. USE NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: EHS observed garam masala, curry powder, chili powder, salt, flour, sugar, msg without labels in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC agreed to make labels by next inspection

violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of mustard seeds, cardamom pods, etc
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC agreed to acquire new approved reusable containers for spice storage
